description: CoreCraft is a next-gen Minecraft network. Survival, Events, Minigames, Duels!
body:
# CoreCraft

**CoreCraft** is a next-gen Minecraft network built around one thing: real survival gameplay that actually keeps you coming back.

At the heart of the server is a fully featured **Survival SMP** with a living, breathing economy. Set up your own shop, protect your land, grind your way up the ranks, and build something worth showing off.

Whether you want to perfect a mega base, corner the market on rare resources, or just vibe with others on a massive community project, there’s always something happening and always a reason to log back in.

## More Than Just Survival

Outside of Survival, the lobby has plenty to offer too:

* Minigames
* Duels
* Cosmetics
* Seasonal events
* Community activities

These features keep the server fresh and give you more ways to enjoy CoreCraft beyond the SMP.

## Survival, Upgraded

CoreCraft runs smooth, keeps systems fair, and has an active team that regularly updates and improves the server. It keeps that classic SMP feeling while removing the rough edges older servers used to have.

Come build your base, run the economy, make some allies — or enemies — and leave your mark.

**CoreCraft is survival, upgraded.**
